headlines.headline: LOUISIANA JUDGE RULES RJ LUIS ELIGIBLE FOR LSU AS TRANSFER-ELIGIBILITY CHAOS CONTINUES
headlines.detail: A Louisiana judge ruled that former G-Leaguer RJ Luis is eligible to play this season at LSU under Will Wade, the latest in a wave of state-court rulings granting eligibility outside the NCAA's own process. Utah's Noam Yaacov was ruled ineligible and will pursue a pro career overseas; Clemson's Dillon Hunter is returning for a fifth season.

headlines.headline: CLIPPERS, RAPTORS IN TRADE TALKS FOR KAWHI LEONARD AS OFFSEASON SHAKEUP CONTINUES
headlines.detail: The Clippers and Raptors have been in trade discussions for All-NBA forward Kawhi Leonard for several weeks. The Kings are waiving DeMar DeRozan, making him a top remaining free agent, and Rockets guard Fred VanVleet is opting into his $25M player option for 2026-27.

headlines.headline: BROWNS NAME DESHAUN WATSON WEEK 1 STARTER OVER SHEDEUR SANDERS
headlines.detail: Cleveland named Deshaun Watson its Week 1 starter over rookie Shedeur Sanders, his first regular-season start since re-tearing his Achilles. Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase left Tuesday's practice with a minor knee hyperextension; the Texans traded for WR Kayshon Boutte from New England.

headlines.headline: COLLEGE FOOTBALL OPENS SATURDAY: KIFFIN'S LSU DEBUT AND PENN STATE'S RESET HEADLINE WEEK 1
headlines.detail: The 2026 season kicks off Saturday, the third year of the 12-team CFP, with Lane Kiffin's move from Ole Miss to LSU and Penn State's rebuild among the top storylines after preseason bowl projections were released Tuesday. Indiana's Curt Cignetti, coming off a 16-0 season, headlines coaches chasing an encore.
